hmong: Kuv muab piam thaj me ntsis rau hauv kuv lub khob tshuaj yej.
english: I put a little sugar in my cup of tea.

hmong: Nws muab piam nuas me ntsis rau hauv cov kua zaub kom qab dua.
english: They add a little MSG to the soup to make it more flavorful.

hmong: Niam ntxiv nab pas me ntsis rau hauv cov kua zaub kom qab dua.
english: Mom adds a little fish sauce to the soup to make it more flavorful.

hmong: Kuv nphoo fwj txob rau saum lub qe kib.
english: I sprinkle black pepper over the fried egg.

hmong: Nws muab kua dub rau cov nqaij qaib.
english: They put soy sauce on the chicken.
note: the model wrote `los marinate` — an English word in the Hmong. Replaced with the batch's own `muab … rau` pattern

hmong: Kuv nyiam noj nqaij nrog kua liab me ntsis.
english: I like to eat meat with a little chili sauce.

hmong: Nws txiav kua txob tso rau hauv zaub kib.
english: They cut chili peppers into the stir-fried vegetables.

hmong: Niam muab qhiav tso rau hauv cov kua zaub qaib.
english: Mom puts ginger in the chicken soup.

hmong: Tus kws kos vaj tse tab tom tsim ib lub tsev kawm tshiab.
english: The architect is designing a new school building.
note: HELD. The entry headword is `koj vaj tse`, but `koj` is 'you' — the model wrote `kos vaj tse` (kos = draw/design), which is probably what the entry should say. Fix the entry, then remove `hold`.

hmong: Tus me nyuam ntawd nyiam kos duab tsiaj hauv nws phau ntawv.
english: That child likes to draw animals in their notebook.

hmong: Kuv tus kwv nyeem yeeb yaj duab kas tsoos txhua hmo.
english: My younger brother reads comics every night.

hmong: Nws daim duab kos ntawm lub roob zoo nkauj heev.
english: Their drawing of the mountain is very beautiful.

hmong: Tus kws sau ntawv tsim ib zaj dab neeg txog ib tug tub hluas taug txuj kev.
english: The writer created a fictional story about a young man on an adventure.

hmong: Nws kev yees duab zoo nkauj qhia tau lub hnub poob saum roob.
english: Their beautiful photography shows the sunset over the mountains.

hmong: Cov tub ntxhais hluas kos duab phab ntsa muaj xim ci ntsa iab.
english: The young people made bright, colorful wall art.

hmong: Phau ntawv no muaj kev sau ntawv qhia txog kev cog zaub.
english: This book contains instructional writing about growing vegetables.

hmong: Lub tsev teev ntuj muaj kev kos duab txiaj zoo nkauj rau ntawm phab ntsa.
english: The church has beautiful mosaic art on the wall.

hmong: Nws sau lus paj huam hais txog lub caij nplooj ntoos hlav.
english: They write poetry about spring.

hmong: Peb pom ib daim duab puab pob zeb nyob hauv lub vaj.
english: We saw a stone sculpture in the garden.

hmong: Kuv saib xov xwm thaum sawv ntxov ua ntej kuv mus ua haujlwm.
english: I watch the news in the morning before I go to work.

hmong: Peb kawm keeb kwm Hmoob hauv chav kawm.
english: We study Hmong history in class.

hmong: Tus noog zaum saum ib ceg ntoo.
english: The bird sits on a tree branch.

hmong: Muaj ib tsob tauj nroj loj nyob ze lub laj kab.
english: There is a large bush near the fence.

hmong: Cov paj hauv lub vaj tab tom tawg zoo nkauj.
english: The flowers in the garden are blooming beautifully.

hmong: Cov me nyuam ua si saum cov nyom ntsuab.
english: The children play on the green grass.

hmong: Yawg siv tshuaj ntsuab los pab daws nws qhov mob khaub thuas.
english: Grandfather uses herbal medicine to help relieve his cold.

hmong: Ib daim nplooj poob los rau hauv dej.
english: A leaf fell into the water.

hmong: Peb yub nroj tsuag tshiab rau hauv lub vaj.
english: We plant new plants in the garden.
